scenes.title: Verified scope. Honest limits.
scenes.body:
Native ArkTS/ArkUI: API 20 target, API 23 runtime.

18 native tests; 100 restart cycles.
100 audio starts: p95 25 ms to accepted PCM.

Genuine reader, physical vibration and representative-user studies remain unverified.
scenes.annotation: Developer verification across identified builds | Evidence and build guide in the repository

approval.authorization: Existing user instruction to implement the complete official PLAN and root delegation to assemble the approximately180-second English demo from actual native clips. This is delegated execution approval, not a claim of personal user review of these cuts.

sourceBuilds.2616f496c2c67ef58a688e494fc8eb8be2090199: Primary offline, touch, resumed lesson, new AI request and already-published ready revision captures. Historical development build; not the final source snapshot.
sourceBuilds.ce00562d8321872cea88c02253d609942e03f8d8: Historical successful speech preparation and publication session. Earlier geometry-review footage began on a preceding build whose exact hash is not asserted here.
sourceBuilds.a40c63d2b0b63ae0a5ae5984f8cb585532e9b242: 18 native tests and 100 local-audio starts passed. Measurements are tied to this artifact; subsequent release fixes need their own verification.
sourceBuilds.1209c87125492cd145ea06a0480d84cc16b5e37c: Final release candidate built from committed source 2642efe. The first 7 seconds show this installed artifact; all other flow excerpts retain their own historical build labels.

sourceCaptureLimits: Actual framebuffer captures may hold the last received frame between VNC updates. Authoring excerpts are explicitly condensed. Audio is isolated QEMU output with approximate UTC start alignment, not physical acoustic timing.
policy: Captions beside actual native recordings. Cuts and accelerated author excerpts are labelled. No fabricated UI state.

completedChecks: Strict decoding of all4320 frames and audio
All17 scene midpoint captions plus selected action boundaries
Independent sampled factual/visual review and final intro follow-up
Captured source/final audio sample correlation and local machine transcription
limits: Visual review used every scene midpoint and selected important boundaries, not continuous human viewing of all motion.
No independent human listening claim is made. Cached local machine transcription and exact decoded PCM identity support one audible label only.
Frame capture can hold the last actual VNC frame between updates. Caption readability does not establish accessibility certification.
review.audioCoverage: Machine recognition supports Evaporation only. The initial two-label expectation did not pass and is preserved. The film does not claim both visual selections were heard.

finalReleaseArtifact.remainingScenes: Historical identified builds, not a claim that all footage was recorded on the final HAP.
